description: This Java interface defines custom assertions for Jsonifiable objects with predicates, facilitating equality checks based on selective fields defined by predicates.

classes.name: JsonifiableWithPredicateAssert
classes.description: An interface providing assertion methods for Jsonifiable objects with predicate-based equality checks.

methods.name: hasEqualJson
methods.description: Asserts that the fields matched by the given predicate are the same for both the actual and expected Jsonifiable objects.
